role: The native explosion: doExplosionA's 16x16x16 ray march into doExplosionA's HashSet (jorder.c's jord_set3: keys in insertion order, the JDK 8 order computed), the entity damage and knockback pass with World.getBlockDensity, then doExplosionB's block destruction with drops, TNT chain priming and the flaming fire placement, run under blockcb_env.
gpu: its former globals, function statics and lazily built tables are gone (lane/gpuenv, L2): per-environment state lives in struct env (csrc/engine/env.h), per-dimension state in the replay's dims, constant tables are built before main; csrc/tests/globals.sh lists what is left
line 175, function expl_env_item_drop: calloc of a new ie_ent per dropped item inside the tick

function expl_run_extras: the affected set is jord_set3 over the frame (the rays' first adds are its keys, an open-addressed index, per-bin counts for the treeify guard); the HashSet order is a counting sort by JDK bin (lane/gpuorder, L4)
line 249, function expl_run_extras: ray march loop bounded only by the float power decrement (var14 > 0), terminates but has a data-dependent trip count
lines 84-101, function block_density: triple float-step loop whose trip count depends on the box size
line 340, function expl_run_extras: iew->blast_entities callback function pointer into the owner world; expl_extra callbacks at lines 392 and 414
lines 431-498, function expl_run_extras: saves and overwrites the global blockcb_env for the duration
lines 139-141 and 448, 458: fprintf to stderr when explosion_debug is set

function expl_run_extras: the entity frames, the affected set and the affected and first-add lists come from the environment's scratch, one frame per explosion in progress (EXPL_SCRATCH_DEPTH 8: a crystal's blast inside another's); only the probe's expl_result gets heap copies (lane/gpuarena, L3)
notes: Ported against the oracle's ExplosionProbe dump. Resistance always uses blockResistance/5 (exploder treated as null for resistance); blast protection enchantment returns the value unchanged (no armour on the kinds carried). Not ported: the players' knockback map, the S27PacketExplosion fan-out, the post-run affected-position clear. The Java member names for Block/EntityItem are inferred from comments, not diffed against each Java method.
